title: Game 6: Hans vs Magnus
notes: Game 6 of 20 in the experiment. Magnus (the learner) reads his notebook before every move; Hans (the control) has no notebook.
result_text: Draw: not enough pieces left to checkmate

new_lessons: When a knight is attacked, verify the retreat square isn't itself attacked by a pawn advance (like d5) before moving there.
Before committing a knight to a seemingly strong outpost, calculate opponent's immediate pawn pushes that could trap or win it.
When choosing between two retreat squares, prefer the one furthest from enemy pawn advances, not just the "safe-looking" one.
